dedupe_keys.name: chinese belt and road power sector investments 2013 2023

description: The Belt and Road energy research team publishes project-level records of 412 Chinese overseas power investments from 2013 through 2023. The Figshare deposit contains an Excel workbook, a field dictionary and a Python notebook for loan-repayment calculations. The workbook records technical project attributes and financial terms including interest rates, loan maturity and grace periods; the article says some terms are imputed from public documents. Coverage spans projects in Belt and Road countries, not all Chinese foreign investment. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. The records can inform generation-capacity and investment scenarios, with model-pypsa providing a separate power-system context. A caveat is that announced finance and modelled repayment terms do not prove that a plant was completed or operates at its reported capacity. Original sources and imputation flags need checking before project-level forecasts. The own metadata and manifest were read without opening spreadsheet rows or running the loan notebook.
